sv.title: Toppchef på Mips dumpar aktier
sv.summary: Hjälmbolaget Mips operativa chef Cedric Marmeys sålde i onsdags 3.100 aktier i bolaget till kursen 451,40 kronor.

en.title: Mips top executive dumps shares
en.summary: Helmet company Mips' chief operating officer Cedric Marmeys sold 3,100 shares in the company on Wednesday at a price of SEK 451.40.
